notes.content:

notes.title: Repair & Medikit
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/1c29f6836a956624d1ab3296f3475588f82d4027.png[/img]
[h3]
Have you ever been upset you almost killed that tank but the player has repaired it to 100%?
And you can't even heal yourself to 50%?
Balance has changed!
[b]Now Repair will restore only 50% of vehicle's health, and the Medikit will heal 100 hp[/b]
(it wouldn't be 100% if you have the Armor)
Also Repair/Heal is not instant anymore! It takes some time to perform the action.
[/h3]

tags.balance_change: Now Repair will restore only 50% of vehicle's health, and the Medikit will heal 100 hp

notes.title: Straight hands Cooldown
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/50a0903e1dc57d893fc09c285dba1ac3c22956ab.png[/img]

Good hunt![/h3]

notes.title: Cooldown for the Items
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/fc31473e65fe74278a114b50498fd041fa1756a3.png[/img]
[h3][b]ATTENTION![/b]

Now there's a cooldown for the consumable items (medikits, repairs, etc.) - [b]10 seconds.[/b]

Circle shaped indicator with a lock is telling you when the item is ready to use.

[b]FOR NOW[/b] it's made with my butt, so the indicator will be shown even if you didn't used the item (you attempted to use the Repair while not in the vehicle, for instance). And even if there's nothing in the item slot at all.
Don't mind it. It will be fixed with the straight hands soon. But for now we just needed the fast way to show the readiness of the items.

Good hunt![/h3]

tags.balance_change: Now there's a cooldown for the consumable items (medikits, repairs, etc.) - 10 seconds.

notes.title: Cut the Chatter!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/f4e5f3c155c8ce51271a62023e978cfd1936b060.png[/img]
[h3]You've came [b]to play[/b] and [b]chat[/b] with your fiends, but the soy boy from the opposite team keep flooding the chat with his bullcrap?
Now you are able [b]to Shut him Up[/b] and [b]not see his messages in the chat.[/b]
All you have to do is click the icon in the players list.
[b]It can be made:[/b]
[list]
[*] After your death and before you click the resurrection button.
[*] Pressing ESC key (it will bring up the menu and unlock the mouse cursor), and holding the TAB key (it will show the players list)
[/list]
Good hunting![/h3]

tags.feature: Now you are able to Shut him Up and not see his messages in the chat.

notes.title: Friend or Foe?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34479348/e65a4a698d7e006b2885b5d453d478c7c89214c3.png[/img][h3]Small but important innovation!

Now your [b]allies [/b]are marked with [b]GREEN [/b]color. And your [b]enemies [/b]are marked with [b]RED[/b]

It was made for the newcomers, who are unable to recognize what fraction they belong to, and attacking the red ones just because red = enemy.

[/h3]
And yes i know the problems with fraction assignation when you're entering the game. Already fixin it.

[h1]ALSO, NOW YOU CAN PLAY ON WIN7[/h1]
